article_context: 作者通过对英格兰公共图书馆的独立评估反驳“图书馆陈旧、正在消失”的刻板印象，列举图书馆提供的多元公共服务，同时指出关闭与访问量下降的危机，并呼吁通过统一品牌、跨馆借阅和儿童自动入会等方式提高使用率。

article.title: 阅读 Text 1 · 公共图书馆远比刻板印象更有活力
article.background: 作者通过对英格兰公共图书馆的独立评估反驳“图书馆陈旧、正在消失”的刻板印象，列举图书馆提供的多元公共服务，同时指出关闭与访问量下降的危机，并呼吁通过统一品牌、跨馆借阅和儿童自动入会等方式提高使用率。

sentences.en: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?
sentences.zh: 问起公共图书馆，人们脑海里往往会浮现一种固定印象：灰尘扑扑、老派陈旧，是小时候喜欢去的地方；可就像英国海滨小镇一样，如今你还会去吗？

segments.text: Ask people about public libraries and a certain image springs to mind: dusty, old-fashioned, the sort of place you enjoyed as a child but, rather like a British seaside town, would you go there now?

sentences.en: And anyway—aren’t they all closing?
sentences.zh: 再说，它们不是都在陆续关闭吗？

segments.text: And anyway—aren’t they all closing?

sentences.en: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.
sentences.zh: 然而现实惊人地不同——文化部门委托我对英格兰公共图书馆开展独立评估，而这份报告已于昨日发布，我在调查中对此有了切身体会。

segments.text: The reality is startlingly different, as I discovered when the culture department commissioned me to conduct an independent review of English public libraries, published yesterday.

sentences.en: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 走访全国各地的图书馆时，我惊讶地发现，图书馆共有2,892家，数量是麦当劳门店的两倍还多。

segments.text: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.

sentences.en: Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity.
sentences.zh: 走进任何一家图书馆，你都会看到一派繁忙景象。

segments.text: Enter any one of them and you will find a hive of activity.

sentences.en: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.
sentences.zh: 书籍当然是、也永远应当是图书馆的核心，但那里还提供众多其他服务：就业咨询、语言课程，以及数字接入与支持。

segments.text: While books are, and should always be, at the heart of any library, a multitude of other services are offered: employment advice, language classes or digital access and support.

sentences.en: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 有些图书馆设有商业与知识产权中心，可以帮助企业主和创业者。

segments.text: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.

sentences.en: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP's surgery.
sentences.zh: 许多图书馆还有护士驻点进行基础健康检查，并与全科医生诊所建立联系。

segments.text: Many have nurses on site to carry out basic health checks, with a link to the GP's surgery.

sentences.en: There are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.
sentences.zh: 还有些图书馆让年轻人免费借用达到国际足联标准的足球。

segments.text: There are libraries where young people can borrow a Fifa-standard football free.

sentences.en: In return for all of this, you'll be asked for precisely nothing.
sentences.zh: 而享受这一切，你恰恰无需付出任何东西。

segments.text: In return for all of this, you'll be asked for precisely nothing.

sentences.en: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.
sentences.zh: 这里不收取费用，也绝不会要求你证明或解释自己；你只会被欢迎进来，需要帮助时有人相助，不需要时也不会受到打扰。

segments.text: There will be no charge and you will never be asked to justify or explain yourself; you will simply be welcomed in, offered help if you need it, and left alone if you do not.

sentences.en: There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same.
sentences.zh: 无论公共还是私人机构，都没有别的地方能作出同样的承诺。

segments.text: There is no other institution, public or private, that can say the same.

sentences.en: Yet sill our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的图书馆仍常常被忽视，未受到应有重视。

segments.text: Yet sill our libraries are often overlooked and underappreciated.

sentences.en: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
sentences.zh: 图书馆总体访问量正在下降，而地方政府持续承受财政压力，许多图书馆因此举步维艰。

segments.text: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.

sentences.en: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed.
sentences.zh: 自2010年以来究竟关闭了多少家图书馆，各方说法并不一致。

segments.text: The number of libraries that have closed since 2010 is disputed.

sentences.en: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
sentences.zh: 英国特许公共财政与会计协会的年度调查称，全英国接近800家；而艺术委员会的官方统计记录显示，英格兰为230家。

segments.text: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.

sentences.en: It is, of course, 230 libraries too many.
sentences.zh: 当然，即便是230家，也已经多得不能接受。

segments.text: It is, of course, 230 libraries too many.

sentences.en: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们想为后代保护图书馆，就必须让更多人了解图书馆以及它们所做的工作。

segments.text: So if we are to protect our libraries for future generations, we must raise awareness of them and the work they do.

sentences.en: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
sentences.zh: 这份评估建议开展全国性品牌宣传，让图书馆在现实生活中拥有更强的存在感；同时重新引入一项制度，使会员可凭同一张卡使用全国任何图书馆，并为儿童自动办理会员资格。

segments.text: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.

sentences.en: If we don't use them, we will end up losing them.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不去使用图书馆，最终就会失去它们。

segments.text: If we don't use them, we will end up losing them.

sentences.en: And for those who haven't been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.
sentences.zh: 而那些很久没有去过图书馆的人，再次走进去时也许会为眼前的一切感到惊讶。

segments.text: And for those who haven't been to a library for some time, they may be surprised by what they find.
